title: Add licensing to your app
summary: Licensing how-to with page-level SDK choice, own-UI lane, state copy keys and Help URLs.
compare: SDK choice is separate from lane tabs.
Own UI lists every state with its copy key and Help URL.
The check uses Verified rather than a success pill.

designReview.reviewer: pkey-ux-reviewer (rendered consumer, developer and brand lenses)
designReview.verdict: Developer lane review passed after the phone SDK picker, App/Console handoff and shared desktop chrome were corrected.

findings.issue: Six SDK labels overflowed the phone picker.
findings.resolution: Phone now retains the selected Swift tab and exposes a compact “5 more” affordance; desktop and tablet retain all SDK labels.

findings.issue: The guide asserted Verified without showing the App and Console route to Integration.
findings.resolution: Added App and Console numbered steps that point from the licensing gate to Integration → Licensing → Verified on macOS; every state row now uses its exact message id in `/docs/help/code/<id>/`.

findings.issue: The desktop header stopped at search and omitted shared Docs chrome.
findings.resolution: Restored Developer changelog, Console and Theme controls.
